scripts.generate-compile-commands: node-gyp configure --release -- -f gyp.generator.compile_commands_json.py; mv Release/compile_commands.json .; rm -rf Debug Release
scripts.prebuild: prebuild --target 37.2.5 --runtime electron --verbose && mv prebuilds/@bugsnag/* prebuilds && rm -r prebuilds/@bugsnag
scripts.prebuild:x64: prebuild --target 37.2.5 --runtime electron --arch x64 --verbose && mv prebuilds/@bugsnag/* prebuilds && rm -r prebuilds/@bugsnag
